name: Yeti Tales
description: Welcome to the neighborhood book store, where mascot Yetili comes to life for adventures during storytime with Nina and Leon.

videos.title: Me First
videos.overview: What will Yetili read us today? How about a story he hasn't heard yet, with a hero that is little like him as well?

videos.title: I'm the Strongest
videos.overview: Our three heroes ask: "Mirror, mirror on the wall, who's the handsomest of all?" The mirror can't decide!

videos.title: Dino Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Nina and Leon are playing with their dinosaur figurines. Which one is the tallest? Strongest? Leon thinks it's a draw...and Yetili reads.

videos.title: Poka & Mia
videos.overview: Nina and Leon want Yetili to read them one of the Poka & Mia books...but they can't agree on which one. Yetili suggests they draw straws!

videos.title: Princess Flora and Her Pony Buttercup
videos.overview: Leon pretends he's a knight in shining armor and wants Nina to play the princess in her castle. But she wants to play a knight, too!

videos.title: The Speedy Knight
videos.overview: The mice are impatient to hear their story. Oh no, let's take our time and settle down before we read about Sir Full-throttle, the valiant knight.

videos.title: Beddy Bye
videos.overview: The mice come along singing a children's song. Yetili joins in, but he sings off key. He decides to read a story, because that's what he does best.

videos.title: The Three Billy Goats
videos.overview: Nina and Leon come into the bookstore when Yetili is napping. They decide to pick a book all by themselves, one at the very top of a shelf!

videos.title: Ernest & Celestine's Christmas Stories
videos.overview: Nina and Leon come into the bookstore with great enthusiasm for the Christmas season. Yetili will read them The Christmas Tree.

videos.title: Pomelo
videos.overview: When comparing height, Nina is still the tallest - much to Leon's annoyance! Yetili tells them a story about an elephant who is growing too: Pomelo.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: Yetili can't find the book he wants to read and makes a big mess. This makes Nina and Leon laugh. They eventually confess they hid the book from him.

videos.title: Lian
videos.overview: Nina and Leon are talking in an imaginary language, then Yetili joins in with his own imaginary language! This inspires reading a story from far away.

videos.title: The Monster In The Cupboard Exists, And I Can Prove It
videos.overview: When Nina and Leon show up at the bookstore, they find an incredible mess. Yetili denies any involvement. The Monster in the closet has been at it again!

videos.title: Roll Along, Pancake...
videos.overview: Nina and Leon are having a tea party on the mezzanine. Yetili comes along and has a cup of tea before reading their story.

videos.title: The Little Giant Girl
videos.overview: Yetili teases Leon and Nina: "There you go little mice. I've finished my story." But he hasn't even started! Don't worry…he was only joking. Phew!
